fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The season chooser dropdown used a hidden `<input type="checkbox">` inside a `<label>` as a pure-CSS toggle (checking/unchecking the box on label click to show/hide the menu via the `:checked` sibling selector). This approach has no animation, uses semantically odd markup (`<div>` inside `<label>`), and was inconsistent with the rest of the UI (menu and achievements accordion both use jQuery slideToggle).

## What changed

- **`decksite/templates/seasonchooser.mustache`**: Removed the `<input type="checkbox" class="dd-input">` element and changed the wrapping `<label>` to a `<div>` (no longer needed for form association).
- **`shared_web/static/css/pd.css`**: Removed the `.dd-input { display: none }`, `.dd-input + .dd-menu { display: none }`, and `.dd-input:checked + .dd-menu { display: grid }` rules. Added `display: none` directly to `.dropdown .dd-menu` for the initial hidden state.
- **`shared_web/static/js/pd.js`**: Added `PD.initDropdown()` (called from `PD.init`) that attaches a click handler to `.dd-button` elements — clicking toggles the adjacent `.dd-menu` open/closed with jQuery `slideDown`/`slideUp("fast")`, preserving `display: grid` for the 4-column layout. A document-level click handler closes open menus when clicking outside.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (All checks passed).
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped in 19s. The changed files are a Mustache template, CSS, and JS; unit tests in `shared_web/template_test.py` passed.
